Build

Waiting for Plan + a Process Source…
Runs automatically as soon as the Plan is applied and at least one Process Source is applied: for each Tracker Type, scans the Site Range from the Reference Point (top-most + left-most cell), moving right → right → right, then down, comparing geometry + relative positions + fill colors + merged-cell structure against the Template.

Fixed Build Rules (from spec §22)

  1. No Key file — canceled entirely.
  2. Site Range is the Site Boundary; nothing is searched outside it.
  3. Tracker type names are Named Ranges.
  4. Grouped source: Process Name / Process Code table in one small Named Range. Separate source: one numeric code inside the large Named Range; process name is taken from the uploaded filename.
  5. A merged range = one unit, never split into separate units.
  6. The main Plan never depends on Conditional Formatting.
  7. The actual fill color inside the Template is part of the Pattern.
  8. Matching is spatial (geometry + merge + color), not color alone.
  9. The search starts at the Top-most + Left-most cell inside the Site Range (Reference Point).
  10. Movement is right, then down.
  11. The engine never searches outside the Site Range.
  12. Two merged cells are never counted as two Trackers.
  13. Apply locks the settings.
  14. Edit re-opens them.
  15. No Build before all Named Ranges are found.
  16. No silent Build when the requested count doesn't match the found count — Requested / Found / Missing is always shown.
  17. Execution has its own, separate parser.
  18. Execution relies on Codes/Values; Conditional Formatting is for display/assistance only, never a substitute for the Code.
Excel Named Ranges can point to more than one rectangular area (e.g. A1:B5,C7:D10) rather than a single block, and this engine supports that for the Site Range. Named Ranges are workbook-level and managed through Excel's Name Manager.
